jobs.occupation: B2B Lead – Industry & Education (m/f/d) (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule) - Marketing)
jobs.description:
Your responsibilitiesAs B2B Manager – Industry & Education , you will build strategic relationships with companies, industry associations, innovation stakeholders, and ecosystem partners across Europe. You will design and implement sponsorship and partnership models that generate income and support financial sustainability, negotiating and closing deals, while creating meaningful connections between industry and talent development initiatives.

The role supports two flagship Cross-KIC initiatives: EIT STEM Tech Talent Induction and EIT Talent. EIT STEM Tech Talent Induction is building a STEM talent pipeline through trainings, skilling projects, and a community of industry partners. EIT Talent connects industry with emerging talent through Cross-KIC Innovation Challenges and supports the development of the EIT Alumni Framework and Ambassador Network.

You will secure sponsorships, develop partnership opportunities, support innovation challenges, and collaborate with EIT Health, other EIT KICs, industry partners, and European stakeholders in an international environment.
Your Input
• You design, package and price industry engagement offers across the cluster’s education initiatives, from event and community sponsorships to sponsored Innovation Challenges.
• You define target industry segments and develop value propositions covering sponsorship, talent access, co-creation and visibility formats.
• You build and manage the partner pipeline through proactive outreach and leveraging EIT and Pledger networks.
• You negotiate and secure financial and in-kind contributions, convert one-off sponsorships into recurring collaborations, and contribute to agreed revenue targets.
• You test value propositions with partners and refine engagement models based on market feedback.
• You co-organise networking events, webinars, matchmaking sessions and industry co-designed Innovation Challenges.
• You manage partner relationships beyond delivery, identify follow-on opportunities, and gather feedback to improve formats and offerings.
• You design, validate and continuously improve industry engagement and sponsorship models for both initiatives to support financial sustainability and partner value creation.
• You identify and develop cross-KIC partnership opportunities by leveraging the networks and communities of the eight EIT Knowledge and Innovation Communities.
• You monitor pipeline, revenue and KPIs, and prepare reporting and documentation in line with EIT and Horizon Europe requirements.

Your skills & knowledge What you bring
• You hold a Bachelor's degree or higher in business, marketing, communications, international relations or a related field, or bring equivalent experience in B2B or partnership roles.
• You have proven experience in B2B business development, corporate partnerships, sponsorship sales or fundraising, with a track record of securing sponsorships for programmes, events or communities and closing agreements.
• Experience in education, innovation, entrepreneurship or research environments is an advantage, while experience with European-funded projects (e.g. Horizon Europe, EIT, Erasmus+) and knowledge of the EIT Knowledge and Innovation Communities is a plus.
• You are able to develop commercial offers from segmentation and value proposition development through to packaging and pricing.
• You combine strong pipeline management and CRM skills with the confidence to engage partners through both cold outreach and established networks.
• You bring excellent negotiation, networking, presentation and stakeholder management skills, as well as a good understanding of industry-academia collaboration and the European skills agenda.
• You have strong project and event coordination skills, are able to manage multiple priorities, and are proficient in Microsoft Office.
• You are fluent in English, both written and spoken; additional European languages is a plus.

What we offer
• We are a 100% “Remote First” company, hiring in Germany, Spain, France and Poland.
• The possibility to join offices in various locations around Europe during business travel.
• Flexible working hours.
• Straight forward internal communication, non-hierarchical structure, and freedom to operate with autonomy.
• A large and vibrant network in the healthcare sector, with exposure to high-level and senior representatives from key players and influencers.
• The opportunity to work on critical projects of European interest, contributing to improving the lives of citizens and patients.

About usEIT Health is one of Europe’s largest and most dynamic health innovation communities, dedicated to improving the lives of citizens and patients and strengthening healthcare systems across the continent.
Our mission is simple: to drive healthcare innovation and create positive societal impact across Europe. In a landscape marked by an ageing population, rising chronic disease, workforce shortages, and increasing pressure on healthcare budgets, our community serves as a catalyst, enabling creative thinking, cross-border collaboration, and evidence-based solutions that deliver real-world impact.
As a Knowledge and Innovation Community (KIC) of the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT), our pan-European network brings together over 80 members, exceptional in the worlds of business, education, research and health service delivery, alongside thousands of start-ups, entrepreneurs and healthcare professionals. By combining their collective expertise we help new solutions reach the people and services that need them most.
For more information please visit our website: www.eithealth.eu

jobs.occupation: Early Childhood Educator (German/English) – Bilingual Kindergarden Kaulsdorf (Kindheitspädagoge/-pädagogin)
jobs.description:
Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!Dreieins Innovative Pädagogik gGmbH is a recognized provider of child and youth welfare services that has stood for a distinctive, creative, and achievement-oriented approach to education for over 20 years. Based on our unique educational concept, we educate and care for approximately 900 children with a team of 250 educators in daycare centers and primary schools in Berlin and Aachen. We see ourselves as a learning organization and consider our employees to be key to quality and success.In autumn 2020, we opened our bilingual daycare center (German/English) in a newly constructed building at the Berlin-Kaulsdorf education campus, which also includes another dreieins daycare center, a primary school, and the Bildungszentrum Plus. Our international team of educators shapes the everyday daycare experience in both German and English and cares for up to 160 children.For this position, we are looking for a

State-Certified Early Childhood Educator (m/f/d)
Was bieten wir Ihnen:
• A permanent employment contract with a growing organization
• Attractive salary with regular salary increases
• Additional holiday and Christmas bonuses
• 30 days of annual leave, plus Christmas Eve (December 24) and New Year's Eve (December 31) as paid days off
• Opportunity to participate in educational trips through Erasmus+
• Additional employer benefits, such as BusinessBike, an employer contribution to occupational pension plans, and an employer subsidy for the Deutschlandticket
• Employee discount if your child attends a dreieins primary school
• Where possible, your children can be offered a place at one of our dreieins daycare centers
• Internal training and professional development opportunities in our dreieins creative education programs at the Bildungszentrum Plus
• External training and professional development opportunities, such as qualification as a specialist in integration education, with 100% of the costs covered
• Modern facilities and a family-oriented working environment within a committed team

Welche Aufgaben erwarten Sie:
• Holistic support and development of children in the creative, cognitive, emotional, and motor areas
• Preparation and implementation of age-appropriate educational activities and projects based on the dreieins creativity-focused educational approach and the Berlin Education Program
• Preparation, follow-up, and conducting of parent-teacher meetings
• Supporting children during the settling-in period, observing their development, maintaining language development journals, and preparing developmental reports using the PC-based GABIP program
• Participation in team meetings, the annual dreieins professional development days, and supervision sessions

Was bringen Sie mit:
• You have completed training as a state-certified early childhood educator or have successfully completed a degree in education, social work, or a related field, or hold an equivalent qualification or formal recognition of equivalency as a career changer
• You have some initial professional experience in a daycare setting
• You have a solution-oriented approach and enjoy taking on new challenges
• You are confident in handling challenging situations and remain resilient under stress
• You identify with the principles of creativity-focused education
• You are committed to continuous professional development and further training
• You have good written and spoken English skills and are confident communicating in English

Sind Sie neugierig auf uns geworden? Dann freuen wir uns, Sie kennen zu lernen.We are committed to diversity and equal opportunities and therefore encourage all qualified individuals to apply, regardless of gender, background, age, disability, or other individual characteristics.Learn more about our educational concept on our website at www.dreieins.org. If you have any questions about the application process, please contact us at karriere@dreieins.org.We look forward to receiving your application, including your CV and relevant certificates, exclusively in electronic form (PDF). Please send your application to karriere@dreieins.org.If you have any questions, please contact us by phone at +49 30 420246914.

jobs.occupation: (Senior) Equipment Technician (m/f/d) (Industriemechaniker/in)
jobs.description:
Build Europe's semiconductor future with us!European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH is the joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the first time, global technology leader TSMC is building a semiconductor fab in the heart of Europe, offering cutting-edge manufacturing technologies for next-generation semiconductor products. ESMC represents a shared commitment to strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem.

For our future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated and committed:

Advanced Equipment Technician (m/f/d)

We are building a team and are looking for skilled Advanced Equipment Technicians (m/f/d) to become the backbone of our manufacturing process. In this dynamic role, you will go beyond basic maintenance. You will tackle complex equipment challenges, ensure top-tier quality, and step up as a leader and mentor to our junior technicians. You are a natural problem-solver who loves mastering complex tools and is passionate about mentoring others and driving continuous improvement.
Job Responsibilities
• Execute advanced preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshoot complex, high-level equipment issues with minimal engineering guidance
• Act as a mentor! Lead junior technicians in daily PM and troubleshooting activities, ensure checklists are flawlessly completed, and coach newcomers to success
• Have an eagle eye for detail? You will identify subtle equipment deviations (e.g., rough movements, worn components), report abnormalities, and help drive process stability
• Contribute directly to our Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and demonstrate basic tool troubleshooting for the wider team
• Take ownership of the parts lifecycle - managing scrapped parts and ensuring our inventory is always sufficient and ready to go
• Identify safety risks, create basic safety SOPs, and provide essential safety training to keep your team secure

Your profile
• Successfully completed vocational training in an industrial or mechanical field (IHK certified: Industriemechaniker, Mechatroniker or Elektriker)
• At least 3 years of professional experience in a manufacturing environment
• Practical English skills (Level B1). You must be able to read technical documentation, complete your interview in English
• You are highly reliable, structured, and safety-oriented
• A team-oriented mindset with a strong willingness to learn, adapt, and grow with us
• Ability and willingness to work an 8-hour shift model, which includes nights, weekends, and sometimes public holidays
• Willing to travel to Taiwan for a 6 - 9 month comprehensive training program
• Semiconductor industry experience is nice to have

Reasons to join ESMC
• Security & Perspective: A permanent employment contract and career advancement opportunities in one of Europe's leading semiconductors fabs.
• Company Pension Plan & Financial Benefits : We support your financial well-being with our robust company pension plan. As an ESMC employee, you also benefit directly from TSMC’s performance through an exclusive Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP).
• Relocation Support for Dresden: Moving for us? We’ll provide you with all the support you will need for your relocation and your start in Dresden.
• Training & Development: Depending on your position, you will gain a deeper understanding of the processes involved in operating complex semiconductor equipment through unique hands-on training at the TSMC Newcomer Training Center, while continuously expanding your knowledge.
• Health & Well-Being: An annual budget for your health and well-being (e.g., for sports classes, massages, or relaxation) helps you stay fit.
• Meals & Transportation: Enjoy a daily meal allowance as well as a subsidized public transportation (e.g., for the Deutschlandticket) in Germany.

About usEach journey starts with a first step.
Joining ESMC at this early stage will provide you with the unique opportunity to actively shape the future of the fab in Dresden, boost your career and put your true potential to the test. You will be working in a fast paced, international startup environment whilst at the same time having access to the experience, talent, and resources of the largest and most advanced semiconductor manufacturer in the world, TSMC. You have ample opportunities to learn about TSMC Operations, Digital Transformation, and various advanced Facilities related topics, both in Taiwan and other sites around the world.
Behind the world’s most advanced technology are real people with real passion. Our success is fueled by our core values: Integrity, Commitment, Innovation and Customer Trust (ICIC).
We create a work environment that promotes diversity, ignites passion and enables you to reach your full potential.
At ESMC, we welcome applications from all people, regardless of race, ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age or sexual identity.

jobs.occupation: Instructor Hardware Technical Training (w/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description:
Job Requirements

Do you want to help create the future of healthcare? Our name, Siemens Healthineers, was selected to honor our people who dedicate their energy and passion to this cause. It reflects their pioneering spirit combined with our long history of engineering in the ever-evolving healthcare industry.

We offer you a flexible and dynamic environment with opportunities to go beyond your comfort zone in order to grow personally and professionally. Sounds interesting?

Then come and join our global team as Instructor Hardware Technical Training (f/m/d) to train service professionals on advanced Varian hardware systems and help ensure excellent technical support for our customers worldwide.

Choose the best place for your work - Within the scope of this position, it is possible, in consultation with your manager, to work mobile (within Germany) up to an average volume of 60% of the respective working hours.

Even more flexibility? Mobile working from abroad is possible for up to 30 days a year under certain conditions and in selected countries.

At the Kemnath location, you can look forward to attractive benefits, including subsidies for childcare and holiday care, an EGYM Wellpass corporate fitness membership, as well as many additional perks. You can find more information here.

Please submit your application documents in the English language.

Your tasks and responsibilities:
* You conduct classroom and laboratory training sessions for groups of different sizes, from small expert groups to larger participant audiences
* You perform intermediate equipment maintenance, including PMP/PMI activities, and demonstrate relevant service procedures during training
* You troubleshot basic to advanced technical issues with limited support and guide learners through structured problem-solving approaches
* You interpret schematic diagrams, technical documentation, software materials, and service information to create practical learning experience
* You stay up to date on Varian product capabilities, system updates, and service requirements to ensure that all training reflects the latest standards

To find out more about the specific business, have a look at https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/products-services

Your qualifications and experience:
* You hold a degree in IT, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Technology, or a comparable field with relevant working experience
* You bring experience in field service or equivalent experience in engineering, technical training, manufacturing, or a comparable technical environment.
* You are a certified Radiation Protection Officer and possess strong expertise in electronics
* You have experience delivering technical instruction, ideally in a medical equipment or highly technical environment, and can explain complex topics to diverse audiences
* You are confident using Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and email tools

Your attributes and skills:
* You are fluent in written and spoken English and German and you have strong communication and presentation skills and enjoy enabling others to build technical confidence
* You work independently, apply sound judgment, and make well-considered decisions when solving diverse and complex technical problems
* You are result-oriented, structured, and able to manage classroom delivery, training logistics, and critical deadlines effectively
* You meet the required qualifications to perform electrical operations and to serve as a radiation safety officer in accordance with German regulatory standards
* You are willing to work alternate or second shifts, take on weekend assignments when needed, and travel domestically and internationally up to 50%

Our global team:

Siemens Healthineers is a leading global medical technology company. 74,000 dedicated colleagues in over 70 countries are driven to shape the future of healthcare. An estimated 5 million patients across the globe benefit every day from our innovative technologies and services in the areas of diagnostic and therapeutic imaging, laboratory diagnostics and molecular medicine, as well as digital health and enterprise services.

Our culture:

Our culture embraces different perspectives, open debate, and the will to challenge convention. Change is a constant aspect of our work. We aspire to lead the change in our industry rather than just react to it. That's why we invite you to take on new challenges, test your ideas, and celebrate success. Check our Careers Site at https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers

As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.#myabilityshs

Wish to find out more before applying? Contact us: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com, if you wish to discuss any initial questions with our recruitment team. The contact person handling this job ad is Vanessa Türmer.

We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile in our talent community where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open.

To all recruitment agencies:

Siemens Healthineers' recruitment is internally managed, with external support permitted only when a qualified supplier has established a formal contract with us. Unsolicited candidate submissions and referrals, absent a current supplier contract, do not establish consent and are ineligible for fees. We delete and destroy unsolicited information, thus, would recommend you refrain from any such practices. Your adherence to our policies is appreciated.

jobs.description:
Your daily workout

jobs.occupation: Rare Disease Manager (Key Account Manager) for NF1, Middle East of Germany (all genders) (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

United As One for Patients, our purpose in Healthcare is to help create, improve and prolong lives. We develop medicines, intelligent devices and innovative technologies in therapeutic areas such as Oncology, Neurology and Fertility. Our teams work together across 6 continents with passion and relentless curiosity in order to help patients at every stage of life. Joining our Healthcare team is becoming part of a diverse, inclusive and flexible working culture, presenting great opportunities for personal development and career advancement across the globe.

Your Role: As a Rare Disease Manager (Key Account Manager) for Neurofibromatose Typ 1 (NF1) , you will be at the heart of transforming how patients with rare diseases access life-changing therapies — your work directly influences treatment pathways and outcomes for some of the most underserved patient populations. You will own your territory like a true entrepreneur, taking full accountability for strategy, execution, and sustainable business growth across hospitals, treatment centers, and referral networks. You will develop and execute customized strategic account plans that strengthen centers of excellence, optimize referral pathways, and accelerate time-to-treatment for patients in need. Building deep, trust-based partnerships with physicians, nurses, pharmacists, and multidisciplinary teams will be your daily currency — and you will do it with scientific credibility and genuine care. Leveraging your deep scientific expertise, you will engage healthcare professionals as a peer and trusted partner, translating complex clinical evidence into meaningful conversations that drive better standards of care. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional colleagues in Medical Affairs, Market Access, Marketing, and Commercial teams to align strategies and maximize impact across the healthcare ecosystem. Data is your compass: you will use CRM tools, market analytics, and territory business planning to identify opportunities, monitor performance, and continuously refine your approach. You will champion disease awareness and patient education initiatives, playing a key role in shaping the rare disease landscape in your region. Acting as the voice of the customer, you will bring actionable field insights back to the organization — directly influencing strategy at a national level. This is a rare opportunity to combine commercial excellence with genuine patient impact — if that drives you, this role was made for you.

Your territory covers key hubs across the Middle East of Germany — mainly Dresden, Leipzig and Göttingen area — and ideally, you already call one of these regions home.

Who You Are:

- You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Biology, Chemistry, Pharmacy, Medicine, or a related life science field; a qualification as Pharmaceutical Representative per local regulatory requirements is a plus.
- You bring at least 4–5 years of commercial experience in the pharmaceutical, biotech, or healthcare industry, with a proven track record in strategic account management and market development.
- You have hands-on experience in rare disease environments and a strong understanding of the complex stakeholder dynamics involved.
- You possess deep knowledge of healthcare systems, reimbursement pathways, and patient access processes, ideally with exposure to high-cost specialty therapies.
- You are scientifically agile — able to engage with complex clinical data and translate it into compelling, compliant customer discussions.
- You combine an entrepreneurial mindset with strong analytical capabilities, taking ownership of results and thriving in ambiguous, fast-evolving environments.
- You are a skilled communicator and relationship builder, experienced in working across cross-functional teams and navigating complex stakeholder landscapes.
- You are fluent in German and English and highly willing to travel within your territory, including overnight travel as required.
- A valid driving license is required.

What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

jobs.occupation: Optical Architect (d/f/m) for Optical Instruments (DevOps Engineer)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support Earth Observation & Science projects within Space Systems, Airbus Defence and Space in Ottobrunn is looking for an

Optical Architect (d/f/m)

You will join a multicultural team of engineers specialized in the development of optical (sub-)systems working for Earth Observation & Science projects within Space Systems. jobs.occupation: PhD Position in reproductive mechanobiology (m/f/div) (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description:
We, the Max Planck Institute for Medical Research, are one of 85 institutes and research centers of the Max Planck Society (MPG) for the advancement of science. Our focus is on basic medical research. We currently employ around 270 people in science and administration, mainly at our location in Heidelberg. Another location for our institute is currently being established in Heilbronn. We are also part of the Health + Life Science Alliance Heidelberg Mannheim, an association of the region's leading life science research institutions.

The MPG strives for gender equality and diversity. We welcome applications from all backgrounds. As the MPG has set itself the goal of employing more people with severe disabilities, applications from people with severe disabilities are expressly welcome. In addition, the MPG wants to increase the proportion of women in areas where they are underrepresented. Women are therefore expressly encouraged to apply.

The female reproductive tract is a highly dynamic system in which tissue mechanics, active forces, and fluid flow interact with cellular and physiological processes. Yet, how these physical properties contribute to reproductive function remains poorly understood.

Within the ERC Starting Grant project REPROMECH – Quantitative Mechanics of the Oviduct: Force, Flow, and the Physiological Operating Point, our group investigates how forces and mechanical properties shape the function of the female reproductive system. We combine approaches from reproductive biology, mechanobiology, and experimental biophysics to quantitatively characterize living tissues across cellular and tissue scales.

The doctoral project will investigate the mechanical properties of the female reproductive tract and their relationship to tissue function.

Tasks

- Quantification of mechanical properties of the female reproductive tract using complementary mechanical measurements and advanced microscopy
- Preparation and culture of ex vivo tissue samples
- Histological characterization of biological samples
- Quantitative image and data analysis
- Critical analysis and interpretation of experimental results

Profile

- You hold a Master’s degree or equivalent in reproductive biology, developmental biology, biology, biophysics, physics, bioengineering, biomedical engineering, biotechnology, or a related discipline.
- We are looking for a candidate with strong experimental aptitude, excellent practical laboratory skills, manual dexterity, and a quantitative and analytical mindset.
- You should enjoy technically demanding experimental work, be able to interpret complex data critically and rigorously, and be motivated to work across disciplinary boundaries.
- Willingness to work with laboratory mice and to complete the required laboratory-animal training is essential.
- Previous experience in reproductive biology, experimental biophysics, microscopy, or work with laboratory animals is advantageous but not required. Candidates with a background in reproductive biology and an interest in quantitative and biophysical approaches are particularly encouraged to apply.
- Excellent communication skills in written and spoken English are required.

Our offer

The position is funded for an initial period of three years within the ERC Starting Grant REPROMECH, with the possibility of extension, and is available from 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible.

We offer a vibrant international research environment, access to state-of-the-art infrastructure for quantitative microscopy and mechanobiology, and opportunities for scientific training and conference participation.

Remuneration: 75% of pay group E13 under TVöD Bund.

We look forward to receiving your application, including a cover letter, curriculum vitae, copies of relevant degree certificates and transcripts, and contact details of two academic referees. Applications must be submitted electronically via the application portal (https://bewerbermanagement.net/en/jobposting/5572b068e91236d723de14e45b3737686f35fab70/apply) by 1 November 2026.

For further information, please contact Dr. Stephanie Möllmert (stephanie.moellmert@mr.mpg.de (https://mailto:stephanie.moellmert@mr.mpg.de) ).

For general questions, please contact Ms. Julia Gauglitz (julia.gauglitz@mr.mpg.de (https://mailto:julia.gauglitz@mr.mpg.de) ) from human resources.

jobs.occupation: Junior Simulation Software Developer C/C++ (m/f/d) (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

The A400M is a versatile European tactical airlifter that bridges the gap between traditional transport aircraft and strategic airlift capabilities. It stands as a symbol of industrial excellence and collaborative defense capability.

Be part of this journey and join our team to shape the future of A400M simulation! We develop advanced simulation software for the A400M programme, ranging from high-fidelity Full Flight Simulators (FFS) for pilot training to advanced test facilities for avionics integration and certification. We support the A400M Military Test and Support Facility (MTSF) by providing simulation models that enable the verification and certification of avionics at software, equipment, and system levels. Our work ensures that aircraft updates are accurately represented in both training and test environments, utilizing a tech stack centered on C/C++.

As a Junior Software Engineer in our MTSF team, you will be responsible for the full lifecycle of simulation solutions. You will translate high‑level operational and system requirements from a variety of stakeholders into robust simulation models, design and define the necessary simulation interfaces, develop and test complex models, and drive the successful release and deployment of those models. Throughout the process you will guarantee high‑quality delivery and provide support during customer‑acceptance activities.

Your location:

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Your benefits:

- Attractive salary including holiday pay, Christmas bonus and profit sharing
- 30 days holidays and extra days-off for special occasions
- Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects
- Special benefits: employer-funded pension, employee stock options, discounted car leasing, special conditions for insurances, public transport subsidy, discounts at local businesses
- On-site-facilities: Medical officer for check-ups and other health-related services, canteen and cafeteria, kindergarten nearby

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

Your responsibilities include:

- Developing simulation models based on avionics software to accurately represent aircraft equipment and systems
- Working closely with customers from aircraft development
- Providing solutions to support testing of real aircraft equipment
- Implementing robust real time software components, primarily using C, and integrating both in-house and third-party modules
- Create requirements, test procedures and supporting documentation and perform formal acceptances
- Designing and defining simulation interfaces in close collaboration with internal and external stakeholders
- Driving development excellence by creating tools for automation, code generation, and optimized build pipelines
- Supporting the entire deployment cycle, from initial model development to successful integration and customer acceptance
- Working internationally gives you the opportunity to travel occasionally to meet partners on‑site.

We are looking for candidates with the following skills and experience:

Education:

- We are looking for candidates with a Bachelor's or Master's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline

Professional Experience:

- Relevant experience in the field of software development: - Software design
- Procedural and object orientated programming
- Unit, integration and system testing
- Your proficiency in C/C++ and knowledge of distributed systems and simulation frameworks will be instrumental in this role

Technical Skills:

- Profound knowledge of C/C++
- Knowledge of distributed systems and simulation frameworks
- Scripting languages (e.g. Bash, Python)
- Build Systems (e.g. CMake) and packaging (e.g. conan.io, RPM, DEB)
- Proficiency with Linux and Windows
- Experience with version control systems, office applications, and Atlassian tools (e.g., Confluence, Jira)
- Experience with CI/CD or DevOps tools (e.g., Jenkins) and software development (e.g., VS Code)
- Experience with Avionics buses would be a plus
- Experience with real time applications would be a plus

Work Methods and Soft Skills:

- Familiarity and agreement with agile working methods
- Ability to work in large teams and be an excellent team player
- Ability to work independently
- Proactive approach

Language Skills:

- English: Business fluent
- German, Spanish, French or Italian are a plus

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.
